summary: The study area lies in the Meghalaya plateau foothills; Sarutaru and Marakdola are its previously excavated sites. Indexed fieldwork passage says Marakdola, now Morogdula, was relocated using menhirs, but the old Sarutaru excavation spot remained untraceable. Modern roads, factories and residential development complicate relocation.
